issues.description: The problem statement asks to mark the end of the main loop with the label `loop_end`, but the reference solution defines the label `end_loop` in helloWorld.asm. Students following the statement may use `loop_end`, and any automated check (or comparison with the solution) expecting that exact label will not match.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the label in solution_repository/helloWorld.asm from `end_loop` to `loop_end` (and update any references accordingly), or change the problem statement to require `end_loop`.
